annotations.title: Send input to the running game

description:
Drive the RUNNING game's input: a script of timed actions, keys and clicks, or record real input and replay it on a seeded instance. Input is an action: prove its effect with summer_game_probe.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/game-input"}

action.description: 'script' schedules a timed sequence of synthetic inputs (SimulateInputScript); 'record_start'/'record_stop' capture the game's real input into res://.summer/replays/<id>.json; 'replay' plays a…

clock.description: action:'script' — whether at_frame ('frame', default, exact) or at_ms ('ms') schedules the events.

events.description: action:'script' (required) or 'replay' (instead of recording) — up to 1000 timed events; last event within 36000 frames / 600 s.

action.description: type:'action' — InputMap action name (unknown_action if not bound).

at_frame.description: When to fire, in frames after scheduling (clock:'frame'). Default 0 = the next frame.

at_ms.description: When to fire, in milliseconds after scheduling (clock:'ms'); mapped through --fixed-fps when the instance has one (clock_mapping 'exact'), else the physics tick rate ('approximate').

duration_ms.description: type:'axis' — auto-release after this many ms.

hold_ms.description: type:'action'|'key' — auto-release after this many ms (0 = stays pressed until a release event).

keycode.description: type:'key' — Godot Key enum value (e.g. 32 = Space, 4194321 = Right arrow).

physical_keycode.description: type:'key' — physical Key enum value (alternative to keycode).

props.description: type:'raw' — properties set on the instantiated event.

strength.description: type:'action' — press strength 0..1 (default 1). type:'axis' — signed strength; negative selects action_negative.

type.description: 'action' = InputMap action press/release; 'key' = keycode; 'mouse_click' = click at a position; 'axis' = analog strength between two actions; 'raw' = a recorded InputEvent replayed as {class, props}.

include_motion.description: action:'record_start' — also record mouse/joypad motion events (default false; large).

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

recording.description: action:'replay' — the res://.summer/replays/<id>.json path returned by record_stop.

save_as.description: action:'record_stop' — res://.summer/replays/<name>.json to write instead of a generated id.

seed.description: action:'replay' — assert the replay is reproducible; only accepted on an instance started with summer_play {mode:'offscreen', deterministic:true} (else nondeterministic_instance).

wait.description: action:'script'|'replay' — wait for the last event to fire (default true; the engine caps a waited script at 20 s). Scripts longer than that: wait:false and observe with summer_game_probe.

name: summer_game_input
title: Send input to the running game
